Separate overlaps through deliberate dark outlines and flat color changes, never through cast shadows or realistic illumination.

Do not simplify to a generic waveform logo: retain the full pocket recorder emblem, rim, wrapping ribbon, recording dot and bookmark detail. Sophisticated crisp editorial-vector illustration with enough detail to feel distinctive, not a product photograph or a 3D render. Palette remains midnight navy, muted petrol, warm ivory and copper orange. Uniform midnight-petrol full-bleed square background. Generous app-mask-safe margins. No lettering, words or outer rounded-square border. Produce one finished square icon.
